claims.evidence: Photos 0-3 show two treadle sewing machine stands.
The witness identifies them as sewing machine stands; their compatibility with weaving machines is not demonstrated.

risks.risk: Treadle mechanism or drive wheel may be seized or have worn bearings.
risks.proof: A video showing the treadle being pumped and the wheel spinning freely.

risks.risk: Cast iron frame may have hairline cracks or be structurally unstable.
risks.proof: A video of the stands being shaken to demonstrate rigidity.

risks.risk: Table tops may have water damage or rot on the underside.
risks.proof: Photos of the underside of both table tops.

proof_requests: Video of the treadle and wheel in motion for both stands.
Video showing the stability of the frames when pushed.
Photos of the underside of the blue and wood-grain tops.
Confirmation if drive belts are included.
response.reason: The witness has clearly identified the items as SUMOPREMIUM sewing machine stands. They can be priced as stands only, assuming worst-case mechanical and structural condition.
